Container.Name: eclipse-mapper
Container.Overview:
Every solar eclipse from 1900 to 2100 on an interactive map: paths of totality and annularity, how much of the Sun goes anywhere else, and local contact times for any point you click.
Paths are computed from NASA's Besselian elements rather than traced from images, so they stay sharp at every zoom. Eclipse predictions by Fred Espenak, NASA's GSFC.
Entirely static: the container serves files and runs nothing at request time, and needs no outbound network. Map tiles are fetched by your browser from openfreemap.org, so whichever device you view it on needs internet even though the NAS does not.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the map. Browse to http://TOWER-IP:PORT/
